LanguageData.FB_ManualTentacle_Desc: Direct control over a single colony cargo tendril. Point at an item, corpse or any downed pawn, enemies included: the target lights up if the tendril can take it. Forbidden things count too: the tendril unforbids them on its own. One click and it grows out of the nearest flesh and picks the load up, then trails your cursor without ever leaving flesh territory. A second click chooses where to set the load down; a carried pawn can be tucked into a bed, casket or other suitable container, though a bed will not take an enemy. Right click leaves the mode. Carrying costs no hemogel.\n\nWith nothing in its grip, the tendril can also mend a damaged flesh organoid: click one and it reaches for it, then hold the left mouse button on the organoid to regenerate it quickly, spending network hemogel with every restored point.
